subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: The system shall refuse every normal-route lock, draft-born status change, and locked-version change that lacks its required evidence, and surface every unruled requirement change in the approval request. Hosted actor authority shall remain authenticated; local approval shall enforce FR-50 through FR-52 with the disclosed shared-account limit.
fit_criterion: Hosted ABUSE-2 through ABUSE-8 fixtures remain refused; local readiness, stale/replay, status, and immutable-version fixtures refuse inconsistent evidence; local actor-forgery and direct-ref-write inspection records the accepted lack of protection; the ABUSE-1 silent rewrite remains marked unruled.
